name: Near Death Experiences
overview: Scripture reveals that while physical death is a reality from which no one ultimately escapes, the soul’s destiny is of eternal significance, as God alone holds authority over both body and soul (Matthew 10:28). The psalmist acknowledges God's chastening without surrendering to death (Psalms 118:18), emphasizing God's sovereign protection. Jesus Himself, the only one who has ascended to heaven, assures believers of eternal life through faith in Him (John 3:13, 16), contrasting the everlasting punishment awaiting the unrighteous with the eternal life promised to the righteous (Matthew 25:46). Thus, near death experiences must be understood in light of the biblical truth that eternal life is secured only through Christ, not through human experience or speculation.
